integrity: Proof uses exact stationary renewal occupation and a uniform entrance-position squeeze. Finite checker is only diagnostic.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional, unidirectionally propelled, deterministic positive runs with fixed duration, iid Lomax zero-speed inactive periods of finite mean, harmonic relaxation, and zero translational thermal noise. No claim for random run directions, general run-time laws, or added Brownian noise.
title: Log-Pareto central concentration in a harmonically confined intermittent swimmer
